answer: Vault-sealed provenance ledger: each agent identity gets a hardware-sealed vault holding a unique signing quill, and every action emits a shale-marked provenance record chained to prior entries. Registration requires solving a fresh, random 25-bit partial-hash puzzle whose answer is consumed on submission, so it cannot be repeated or reused. An attacker pays one puzzle-solve (roughly 33M hashes) plus one physical vault per identity, making mass sybil creation cost proportional to real hardware and compute.
